title: Beneficial Exposome Study
official: Beneficial Exposome: Investigating Its Effect on Human Health
summary: The purpose of this study is to explore the positive, holistic health outcomes resulting from regular exposure to naturally occurring compounds predicted to have health benefits. The researchers hope to learn how the human body is influenced by regular exposure to these compounds.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 years of age and older
* Read, speak, and understand English
* Live in the US territory

Exclusion Criteria:

* Mental incapacity and/or cognitive impairment on the part of the patient that would preclude adequate understanding of, or cooperation with, the study protocol
* Is pregnant
* Is breastfeeding
* Has epilepsy
* Has allergies to Cupressaceae family of plants, common plants include redwoods, junipers, cypress, cedar, fir, and sequoia
